product.name: Vistara ProTrip 3000
product.description: Vistara ProTrip 3000 is a lightweight yet robust tripod designed for DSLR and mirrorless cameras. The frame is constructed from high‑strength aluminum alloy with carbon‑fiber legs, providing stability on uneven surfaces. A 1/4‑inch screw head allows quick attachment to any standard camera. The tripod collapses to a compact 30 cm height for travel and expands to a maximum 150 cm for studio use. Integrated rubber feet prevent slippage, and a quick‑release plate facilitates fast mounting. Ideal for photographers who need a portable yet durable support for handheld shooting, video, or studio setups.
